The framework reads the verse against Matt 12:29's binding-the-strong-man: the wisdom-stream knew the chains-prepared and the abyss-of-condemnation as the eschatological-architecture awaiting Azazel and his hosts; the King at Matt 12:29 walks the inaugurated-action that culminates in the architecture the wisdom-stream had named.

quote: And he answered and said unto me: They have witnessed those that have been guilty of the offence of their sin, and they have rejected its sentence: and they have practised the works which the watchers of heaven have taught — and they have no honour before Yahuah (the Lord); and they shall not have any rest: that is the appointed time for them and there is no place of repentance for them.
live_here: And these—they have no place of repentance for ever, because they have shown them what was hidden, and they are the damned: but as for thee, my son, Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits knows that thou art pure, and guiltless of this reproach concerning the secrets.
live_proposed: And He said unto me: “Because of their unrighteousness their judgement has been determined upon and shall not be withheld by Me for ever. Because of the sorceries which they have searched out and learnt, the earth and those who dwell upon it shall be destroyed.”
note: *And he answered and said unto me: They have witnessed those that have been guilty of the offence of their sin, and they have rejected its sentence: and they have practised the works which the watchers of heaven have taught — and they have no honour before Yahuah (the Lord); and they shall not have any rest: that is the appointed time for them and there is no place of repentance for them.* 1 Enoch 65:11 names THE direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the no-place-of-repentance architecture: those who have witnessed-the-sin and rejected-the-sentence and practiced-the-works-of-the-watchers have no-place-of-repentance. The framework reads the verse against Matt 12:32: the deliberate-attribution of the Ruach's-work to demonic-agency is the witnessing-and-rejecting-the-sentence pattern the wisdom-stream had named — the disposition hardened against correction with no repentance remaining. The Pharisaic-attribution Yahusha (Jesus) is responding to IS the diagnostic-instance of the architecture 1 Enoch 65:11 had named at its terminus.

quote: And in those days shall the earth also give back that which has been entrusted to it, And Sheol also shall give back that which it has received, And hell shall give back that which it owes.
live_here: And in those days shall the earth also give back that which has been entrusted to it, And Sheol also shall give back that which it has received, And hell shall give back that which it owes.

The framework reads the verse against Matt 12:40's sign-of-Yonah three-days-and-three-nights-in-the-heart-of-the-earth: the wisdom-stream knew the earth-and-Sheol-giving-back-the-dead architecture; the King at Matt 12:40 names the inaugurated-form of the architecture in his own future-resurrection that the Yonah-typology pre-announces. The Yonah-vomited-out-by-the-fish at Yonah (Jonah) 2:10 is the typological-anchor the King draws; the wisdom-stream architecture of Sheol-giving-back is the framework-context.

quote: And the wisdom of the Lord of Spirits hath revealed him to the holy and righteous; for he hath preserved the lot of the righteous, because they have hated and despised this world of unrighteousness, and have hated all its works and ways in the name of the Lord of Spirits: for in his name they are saved, and he is the avenger of their life.
live_here: And the wisdom of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath revealed him to the holy and righteous; For he hath preserved the lot of the righteous, Because they have hated and despised this world of unrighteousness, And have hated all its works and ways in the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits: For in his name they are saved, And according to his good pleasure hath it been in regard to their life.
live_proposed: And the wisdom of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath revealed him to the holy and righteous; For he hath preserved the lot of the righteous, Because they have hated and despised this world of unrighteousness, And have hated all its works and ways in the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits: For in his name they are saved, And according to his good pleasure hath it been in regard to their life.

The framework reads the verse against Matt 13:11's *because it is given unto you to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it is not given.* The Greek *dedotai* (passive-perfect-tense, *it has been given*) names a giving-that-precedes-the-hearing; the wisdom-stream had named the architecture at the elect-receiving register. The disciples-hear because they have-been-given-to-hear; the multitudes-do-not-hear because they have-not-been-given. The giving precedes; the response reveals. Election-precedes-hearing per Red Line #11.

quote: And Uri'el said to me: "Here shall stand the angels who have connected themselves with women, and their spirits assuming many different forms are defiling mankind and shall lead them astray into sacrificing to demons as gods, (here shall they stand,) till the day of the great judgment in which they shall be judged till they are made an end of.
live_here: And Uriel said to me: ‘Here shall stand the angels who have connected themselves with women, and their spirits assuming many different forms are defiling mankind and shall lead them astray into sacrificing to demons as gods, (here shall they stand,) till the day of the great judgement in which they shall be judged till they are made an end of.
live_proposed: And Uriel said to me: ‘Here shall stand the angels who have connected themselves with women, and their spirits assuming many different forms are defiling mankind and shall lead them astray into sacrificing to demons as gods, (here shall they stand,) till the day of the great judgement in which they shall be judged till they are made an end of.

The framework reads the verse against Matt 13:19's *when any one heareth the word of the kingdom, and understandeth it not, then cometh the wicked one, and catcheth away that which was sown in his heart.* The wicked-one Yahusha (Jesus) names is operationally the same actor the wisdom-stream had named — the spirits-of-the-watchers who lead-mankind-astray into sacrificing-to-demons-as-gods. The wicked-one snatches the seed by leading-the-hearer-astray; the wisdom-stream had named the architecture; the King names the operative-form at the parable-of-the-sower register. The disposition-to-be-led-astray (the not-understanding of v.19) is what the wicked-one exploits.

live_here: And it came to pass when the children of men had multiplied that in those days were born unto them beautiful and comely daughters.

note: *And it came to pass when the children of men had multiplied that in those days were born unto them beautiful and comely daughters. And the angels, the children of the heaven, saw and lusted after them, and said to one another: "Come, let us choose us wives from among the children of men and beget us children."* 1 Enoch 6:1-2 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the watchers' incursion: the children-of-the-heaven saw-and-lusted-after the daughters-of-men and took-wives-from-among-them. The framework reads the verse as THE foundational-anchor for the tares-sown-by-the-enemy at Matt 13:25. The watchers' incursion produced the corrupted-line-of-the-giants and the spirits-of-the-giants that operate within-the-field-of-the-world as the seed-of-the-wicked-one. The King at Matt 13:25 names the operative-parable-form of the architecture the wisdom-stream had named at the chronological-source register: the enemy-sowing-tares-while-men-slept is the wisdom-stream's watchers-coming-while-men-slept-in-Yared (Jared)'s-days.

quote: And to Gavri'el (Gabriel) said Yahuah (the Lord): "Proceed against the bastards and the reprobates, and against the children of fornication: and destroy [the children of fornication and] the children of the Watchers from amongst men: and cause them to go forth: send them one against the other that they may destroy each other in battle: for length of days shall they not have."
live_here: And to Gabriel said Yahuah (Lord): ‘Proceed against the bastards and the reprobates, and against the children of fornication: and destroy [the children of fornication and] the children of the Watchers from amongst men [and cause them to go forth]: send them one against the other that they may destroy each other in battle: for length of days shall they not have.
live_proposed: And to Gabriel said Yahuah (Lord): ‘Proceed against the bastards and the reprobates, and against the children of fornication: and destroy [the children of fornication and] the children of the Watchers from amongst men [and cause them to go forth]: send them one against the other that they may destroy each other in battle: for length of days shall they not have.

quote: Then I asked regarding it, and regarding all the hollow places: "Why is one separated from the other?" And such an one has been made for sinners when they die and are buried in the earth and judgement has not been executed on them in their lifetime. Here their spirits shall be set apart in this great pain till the great day of judgement and punishment and torment of those who curse for ever and retribution for their spirits. There He shall bind them for ever. And such a division has been made for the spirits of those who make their suit, who make disclosures concerning their destruction, when they were slain in the days of the sinners. The framework reads the binding-and-loosing-substance in continuity with the Tanakh-rabbinic *asar* (bind) and *hattir* (loose) — the apostolic-authority to declare-the-Torah's-substance against-the-Pharisaic-tradition's-corruption operates downstream-of-the-King's-own-sum-of-judgment, NOT as a magisterial-authority-to-define-doctrine-against-scripture.

quote: And in those days shall the earth also give back that which has been entrusted to it, and Sheol also shall give back that which it has received, and hell shall give back that which it owes.
live_here: And in those days shall the earth also give back that which has been entrusted to it, And Sheol also shall give back that which it has received, And hell shall give back that which it owes.
live_proposed: And in those days shall the earth also give back that which has been entrusted to it, And Sheol also shall give back that which it has received, And hell shall give back that which it owes.
note: *And in those days shall the earth also give back that which has been entrusted to it, and Sheol also shall give back that which it has received, and hell shall give back that which it owes.* 1 Enoch 51:1 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the Sheol-giving-back-the-dead substance — the resurrection-architecture Wisdom of Solomon 16:13's *bringest up again* substance names at the apocryphal-stream-level and 1 Enoch 51:1 articulates at the pseudepigraphal-stream-level. The framework reads the verse against Matt 16:18's *the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.* The gates-of-Sheol do not hold-finally because Sheol shall give-back-that-which-it-has-received at the day-of-Yahuah; the assembly built-on-the-King partakes-of-the-resurrection-substance the wisdom-stream had named the architecture for. The framework reads this in continuity with the broader-resurrection-architecture per the first-resurrection of Revelation 20:4-6 and the gathering-of-the-elect from-the-four-winds at Matt 24:31.

quote: And Azâzêl taught men to make swords, and knives, and shields, and breastplates ... and the metals of the earth and the art of working them ... and the use of antimony, and the beautifying of the eyelids, and all kinds of costly stones, and all colouring tinctures.
live_here: And Azâzêl taught men to make swords, and knives, and shields, and breastplates, and made known to them the metals of the earth and the art of working them, and bracelets, and ornaments, and the use of antimony, and the beautifying of the eyelids, and all kinds of costly stones, and all colouring tinctures.
live_proposed: And Azâzêl taught men to make swords, and knives, and shields, and breastplates, and made known to them the metals of the earth and the art of working them, and bracelets, and ornaments, and the use of antimony, and the beautifying of the eyelids, and all kinds of costly stones, and all colouring tinctures.
note: *And Azâzêl taught men to make swords, and knives, and shields, and breastplates ... and the metals of the earth and the art of working them ... and the use of antimony, and the beautifying of the eyelids, and all kinds of costly stones, and all colouring tinctures.* 1 Enoch 8:1 names THE architectural-root of the *skandalon* (stumbling-block) substance the King's millstone-warning at Matt 18:6 lands-on. The framework reads the verse as the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the substance behind the seed-war: the watchers taught-the-children-of-men the substance that placed-the-stumbling-blocks across the way of the walker. The framework reads this in continuity with the Tanakh-*mikshol* of Vayikra (Leviticus) 19:14 (*thou shalt not curse the deaf, nor put a stumblingblock before the blind*) and Yeshayahu (Isaiah) 57:14 (*take up the stumblingblock out of the way of my people*); the architecture behind those Tanakh-commands is the architecture 1 Enoch names the source of. The little-ones-who-believe whom the King protects with the millstone-warning are the same vulnerable-walkers the Torah-and-prophets named the protection-substance for. FRAMEWORK-MAJOR.

quote: And the whole earth has been corrupted through the works that were taught by Azâzêl: to him ascribe all sin.
live_here: And the whole earth has been corrupted through the works that were taught by Azâzêl: to him ascribe all sin.’
live_proposed: And the whole earth has been corrupted through the works that were taught by Azâzêl: to him ascribe all sin.’
note: *And the whole earth has been corrupted through the works that were taught by Azâzêl: to him ascribe all sin.* 1 Enoch 10:8 names the wisdom-stream's articulation of the inevitability-of-offences-in-the-present-age substance — the whole earth has-been-corrupted by the watcher-taught substance, and the offences-coming-of-necessity (Matt 18:7's *it must needs be that offences come*) is the architectural-consequence of the corruption-already-running. The framework reads the verse against Matt 18:7's *woe unto the world because of offences! for it must needs be that offences come; but woe to that man by whom the offence cometh.* The inevitability does-not-excuse the man-by-whom-the-offence-comes; the architecture-of-the-fallen-age makes the offences-inevitable, and the kingdom-citizen-who-becomes-the-substance-that-causes-the-stumble has joined-himself to the watcher-substance the kingdom-came-to-undo. The framework reads this in continuity with Yeshayahu (Isaiah) 24:5-6's *the earth also is defiled under the inhabitants thereof; because they have transgressed the laws, changed the ordinance, broken the everlasting covenant. Therefore hath the curse devoured the earth.* The earth's-defiling and the curse's-devouring are the architecture 1 Enoch names the source-of and the King-names the consequence-of at the millstone-warning.

quote: Here shall stand the angels who have connected themselves with women, and their spirits assuming many different forms are defiling mankind and shall lead them astray into sacrificing to demons as gods.
live_here: And Uriel said to me: ‘Here shall stand the angels who have connected themselves with women, and their spirits assuming many different forms are defiling mankind and shall lead them astray into sacrificing to demons as gods, (here shall they stand,) till the day of the great judgement in which they shall be judged till they are made an end of.
live_proposed: And Uriel said to me: ‘Here shall stand the angels who have connected themselves with women, and their spirits assuming many different forms are defiling mankind and shall lead them astray into sacrificing to demons as gods, (here shall they stand,) till the day of the great judgement in which they shall be judged till they are made an end of.
note: *Here shall stand the angels who have connected themselves with women, and their spirits assuming many different forms are defiling mankind and shall lead them astray into sacrificing to demons as gods.* 1 Enoch 19:1 names the wisdom-stream's articulation of the leading-astray (*planao* — the same root the King will use for the *go astray* of the sheep at vv.12-13) substance. The framework reads the verse against Matt 18:7's woe-against-the-man-by-whom-the-offence-comes. The fallen-watchers and their spirits operating-in-many-forms across the present-age are the architectural-substance behind every system-of-stumbling-block the King's-millstone-warning lands-on — the institutional-Christianity's antinomian-doctrine, the Hebrew-Roots false-inclusion gospel, the Pharisaic-traditions-of-the-elders, the Galatian-circumcision-party, the Islamic-transfer (the four-costumes per voice skill framework). The lying-spirits-leading-astray are the architecture under the doctrinal-corruptions; the kingdom-citizen-who-joins-the-corruption joins-the-substance the watchers-loosed. The framework reads this with the patience-not-condescension posture per voice skill — the little-ones-led-astray are victims-not-enemies; the systems-and-the-leadership-who-perpetuate-them are where the woe lands.

quote: And these places have been made for them until the day of their judgement and until their consummation, till the consummation of their judgement is consummated for ever and ever upon the sinners.
live_here: Here their spirits shall be set apart in this great pain till the great day of judgement and punishment and torment of those who curse for ever and retribution for their spirits. There He shall bind them for ever.
live_proposed: Then Raphael answered, one of the holy angels who was with me, and said unto me: ‘These hollow places have been created for this very purpose, that the spirits of the souls of the dead should assemble therein, yea that all the souls of the children of men should assemble here.
note: *And these places have been made for them until the day of their judgement and until their consummation, till the consummation of their judgement is consummated for ever and ever upon the sinners.* 1 Enoch 22:11 names the wisdom-stream's articulation of the place-of-the-eternal-judgment-substance — the architecture-of-judgment the King names is *better* than the substance the millstone-and-the-sea would produce. The framework reads the verse against Matt 18:6's *it were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck.* The wisdom-stream had named the day-of-the-judgment-and-the-consummation as the substance-the-sinners-against-the-righteous-walk-toward; the King names the millstone-and-the-sea as the lesser-mercy compared with that judgment-substance. The framework reads the *consummation of their judgement* in continuity with the gehenna-substance of the Tanakh-*gei-Hinnom* (Yirmeyahu (Jeremiah) 7:32-33's *valley of slaughter*; Yeshayahu (Isaiah) 66:24's *worm shall not die, neither shall their fire be quenched*) — the destruction the King names against the systems-causing-the-stumble, NOT the inherited-Christian-eternal-conscious-torment doctrine read-back into the substance.

quote: This accursed valley is for those who are accursed for ever: here shall all the accursed be gathered together who utter with their lips against Yahuah (the Lord) unseemly words and of His glory speak hard things. Here shall they be gathered together, and here shall be their place of judgement.
live_here: Then Uriel, one of the holy angels who was with me, answered and said: ‘This accursed valley is for those who are accursed for ever: Here shall all the accursed be gathered together who utter with their lips against Yahuah (Lord) unseemly words and of His glory speak hard things. Here shall they be gathered together, and here shall be their place of judgement.
live_proposed: Then Uriel, one of the holy angels who was with me, answered and said: ‘This accursed valley is for those who are accursed for ever: Here shall all the accursed be gathered together who utter with their lips against Yahuah (Lord) unseemly words and of His glory speak hard things. Here shall they be gathered together, and here shall be their place of judgement.
note: *This accursed valley is for those who are accursed for ever: here shall all the accursed be gathered together who utter with their lips against Yahuah (the Lord) unseemly words and of His glory speak hard things. Here shall they be gathered together, and here shall be their place of judgement.* 1 Enoch 27:2 names THE direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the accursed-valley-of-judgment substance — the Watcher-Book passage (1 Enoch 26-27) describing the valley at the centre of the holy mountain (an explicit topographical-pointer to the *gei-Hinnom* (Valley of the sons of Hinnom) on the southern-edge of Yerushalayim (Jerusalem)). The framework reads the verse against Matt 18:9's *gehenna of fire.* The King's gehenna-substance is the Tanakh-and-wisdom-stream's accursed-valley-of-judgment carried-forward; 1 Enoch 27:2 names the wisdom-stream's identification of the place — *those who are accursed for ever* gathered for the judgment-substance at the place-of-judgment. The framework reads the substance as destruction-substance, not eternal-conscious-maintenance — *here shall be their place of judgement* is the place-where-the-judgment-is-executed, in continuity with 1 Enoch 22:11's consummation-of-the-judgment substance and Yeshayahu (Isaiah) 66:24's carcases-and-worm substance. The disciple cuts-off the hand-foot-eye that causes the stumble because the judgment is real.

quote: And the Lord of the sheep took the staff of His wrath, and cast it upon the earth, and the earth clave asunder, and all the beasts and all the birds of the heaven fell from among those sheep, and were swallowed up in the earth, and it covered them.
live_here: And the dogs and the foxes and the wild boars began to devour those sheep till Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep raised up [another sheep] a ram from their midst, which led them.
live_proposed: And I saw that man, who wrote the book according to the command of Yahuah (Lord), till he opened that book concerning the destruction which those twelve last shepherds had wrought, and showed that they had destroyed much more than their predecessors, before Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep.
note: *And the Lord of the sheep took the staff of His wrath, and cast it upon the earth, and the earth clave asunder, and all the beasts and all the birds of the heaven fell from among those sheep, and were swallowed up in the earth, and it covered them.* 1 Enoch 89:42 names the wisdom-stream's Animal-Apocalypse articulation of the Lord-of-the-sheep's-substance — the One who-acts-to-deliver his sheep from the beasts-and-birds-that-devour. The framework reads the verse against Matt 18:11's *the Son of Adam is come to save that which was lost.* The Lord-of-the-sheep substance of 1 Enoch 89-90 is the wisdom-stream's carrying-forward of the Tanakh-Yechezk'el (Ezekiel) 34 shepherd-substance into apocalyptic-vision-form; the King is the same Lord-of-the-sheep at the historical-pivot, walking-in-flesh to gather-the-scattered-sheep per Red Line #7's reading of the lost-sheep-of-the-house-of-Yashar'el (Israel) mission-scope at Matt 10:6 and Matt 15:24. FRAMEWORK-MAJOR.

quote: And Enoch blessed the Lord of the sheep and said: "Blessed be Thou, O Yahuah (God), Yahuah (the Lord) of the sheep."
live_here: And after that I saw that when they forsook the house of Yahuah (Lord) and His tower they fell away entirely, and their eyes were blinded; and I saw Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep how He wrought much slaughter amongst them in their herds until those sheep invited that slaughter and betrayed His place.
live_proposed: Then I blessed Yahuah (Lord) of glory and said: ‘Blessed be my Lord, Yahuah (Lord) of righteousness, who ruleth for ever.’
note: *And Enoch blessed the Lord of the sheep and said: "Blessed be Thou, O Yahuah (God), Yahuah (the Lord) of the sheep."* 1 Enoch 89:54 names THE direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the Lord-of-the-sheep-title substance — the wisdom-stream identifies the Lord-of-the-sheep with Yahuah by name. The framework reads the verse against Matt 18:12's shepherd-parable. The King's *if a man have an hundred sheep, and one of them be gone astray, doth he not leave the ninety and nine, and goeth into the mountains, and seeketh that which is gone astray?* is the same Lord-of-the-sheep-substance the wisdom-stream had named the substance of — the One who-acts-personally to seek-the-one-strayed. The Tanakh-and-wisdom-stream had named the substance; the King-in-flesh enacts the substance; the substance is the same shepherd at every register.

quote: But behold lambs were borne by those white sheep, and they began to open their eyes and to see, and to cry to the sheep.
live_here: But behold lambs were borne by those white sheep, and they began to open their eyes and to see, and to cry to the sheep.
live_proposed: But behold lambs were borne by those white sheep, and they began to open their eyes and to see, and to cry to the sheep.
note: *But behold lambs were borne by those white sheep, and they began to open their eyes and to see, and to cry to the sheep.* 1 Enoch 90:6 names the wisdom-stream's articulation of the lambs-that-open-their-eyes substance — the post-judgment opening of the eyes-of-the-sheep-who-had-been-blinded under the seventy-shepherds-administration. The framework reads the verse against Matt 18:14's *it is not the will of your Father which is in heaven, that one of these little ones should perish.* The Father's-will is for the lambs-that-open-their-eyes — the substance the King's mustard-seed-faith and the disciples' kingdom-witness gathers; the cause-and-effect-of-hearing per Red Line #11 operates in the architecture of the lambs-who-open-the-eyes being-the-substance who-hear-when-the-Shepherd-calls. The wisdom-stream had named the architecture; the kingdom-witness operationalizes it; the gathering is the Father's-will-substance, not the universalist-overriding-determinism.

quote: And I saw till all the beasts and the birds and the wild animals were gathered, and they all feared the Lord of the sheep, and they began to fall down upon his face and to worship him.
live_here: And I saw till Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep came unto them and took in His hand the staff of His wrath, and smote the earth, and the earth clave asunder, and all the beasts and all the birds of the heaven fell from among those sheep, and were swallowed up in the earth and it covered them.
live_proposed: And I saw till Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep brought a new house greater and loftier than that first, and set it up in the place of the first which had been folded up: all its pillars were new, and its ornaments were new and larger than those of the first, the old one which He had taken away, and all the sheep were within it.
note: *And I saw till all the beasts and the birds and the wild animals were gathered, and they all feared the Lord of the sheep, and they began to fall down upon his face and to worship him.* 1 Enoch 90:18 names the wisdom-stream's articulation of the consummation-rejoicing the Lord-of-the-sheep walks-toward. The framework reads the verse against Matt 18:13's *if so be that he find it, verily I say unto you, he rejoiceth more of that sheep, than of the ninety and nine which went not astray.* The Lord-of-the-sheep's-rejoicing-over-the-found-one is the substance the wisdom-stream had named at the eschatological-consummation register — the gathering-of-the-sheep at the consummation is the same shepherd-substance the King names at the assembly-internal-level. The two-levels of the shepherd-substance — the assembly's-internal-little-ones AND the canon-wide lost-sheep-of-the-house-of-Yashar'el (Israel) mission-scope — both derive from the same Lord-of-the-sheep architecture 1 Enoch had carried-forward from Yechezk'el (Ezekiel) 34.

quote: And he said unto me: "This first is Michael, the merciful and long-suffering: and the second, who is set over all sickness and all wounds, is Raphael: and the third, who is set over all the powers, is Gabriel: and the fourth, who is set over the repentance unto hope of those who inherit eternal life, is Phanuel."
live_here: And he said to me: ‘This first is Michael, the merciful and long- suffering: and the second, who is set over all the diseases and all the wounds of the children of men, is Raphael: and the third, who is set over all the powers, is Gabriel: and the fourth, who is set over the repentance unto hope of those who inherit eternal life, is named Phanuel.’
live_proposed: And he said to me: ‘This first is Michael, the merciful and long- suffering: and the second, who is set over all the diseases and all the wounds of the children of men, is Raphael: and the third, who is set over all the powers, is Gabriel: and the fourth, who is set over the repentance unto hope of those who inherit eternal life, is named Phanuel.’
note: *And he said unto me: "This first is Michael, the merciful and long-suffering: and the second, who is set over all sickness and all wounds, is Raphael: and the third, who is set over all the powers, is Gabriel: and the fourth, who is set over the repentance unto hope of those who inherit eternal life, is Phanuel."* 1 Enoch 40:9 names the wisdom-stream's articulation of the four-presences-before-the-Father substance — the messengers who-have-direct-access-to-the-throne, whose-substance is mercy and long-suffering and healing and repentance-unto-hope. The framework reads the verse against Matt 18:10's *I say unto you, That in heaven their angels do always behold the face of my Father which is in heaven.* The little-ones' guardian-messengers operating in the Tanakh-and-Second-Temple guardian-messenger pattern (Shemot (Exodus) 23:20, Tehillim (Psalm) 91:11, Daniel 10:13, Acts 12:15, Hebrews 1:14) are the same architectural-substance 1 Enoch names for the chief-presences; the disciples' disposition-toward-the-little-ones is bounded by the architectural-substance of the messengers' direct-throne-access on behalf of those little-ones.

quote: Woe to you who are rich! For you have trusted in your riches, And from your riches shall you depart, Because you have not remembered Yahuah (God) of Spirits in the days of your riches.
live_here: And now I say unto you the righteous: Walk not in the paths of wickedness, nor in the paths of death, And draw not nigh to them, lest ye be destroyed.
live_proposed: Woe to you, ye rich, for ye have trusted in your riches, And from your riches shall ye depart, Because ye have not remembered the El Elyon (Most High) in the days of your riches.
note: *Woe to you who are rich! For you have trusted in your riches, And from your riches shall you depart, Because you have not remembered Yahuah (God) of Spirits in the days of your riches.* 1 Enoch 94:3 names THE direct Enochic wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the woe-against-trust-in-riches substance — the same substance the King names at Matt 19:23's *verily I say unto you, That a rich man shall hardly enter into the kingdom of heaven.* The framework reads the verse against the King's-warning. The Enochic-substance had named the architecture-directly: the rich-man's-substance of trusting-in-riches operates against-the-remembering-Yahuah (God)-of-Spirits substance the kingdom-citizen-substance walks. The substance is heart-substance — *where your treasure is, there will your heart be also* per Matt 6:21's Sermon-substance. The Enochic-woes-against-the-rich extended-corpus across 1 Enoch 94-100 unfolds the substance the King-summarizes at Matt 19:23-24. The wisdom-stream had named the architecture-in-extended-form; the King applies the substance at the camel-eye-of-needle-pivot.

quote: Woe to you who acquire gold and silver in unrighteousness And say: "We have become rich with riches and have possessions; And we have acquired everything that we have desired."
live_here: Woe to you, ye sinners, who live on the mid ocean and on the dry land, Whose remembrance is evil against you.
live_proposed: Woe to you, ye sinners, who live on the mid ocean and on the dry land, Whose remembrance is evil against you.
note: *Woe to you who acquire gold and silver in unrighteousness And say: "We have become rich with riches and have possessions; And we have acquired everything that we have desired."* 1 Enoch 97:7 names the Enochic wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the substance-of-the-rich-man's-self-congratulation — the substance the rich-young-ruler's *all these things have I kept from my youth up* at Matt 19:20 carries-by-implication-of-the-young-man's-claim-to-have-acquired-everything-the-young-man-has-desired. The framework reads the verse against Matt 19:23's warning about the rich man's difficulty-entering-the-kingdom. The Enochic-substance names the architecture-of-the-acquired-everything-we-have-desired substance the rich-man-walks-in — the substance the rich-young-ruler had-walked-out at v.22 (the *went away sorrowful: for he had great possessions* substance reveals the heart-the-possessions-hold). The wisdom-stream had named the substance the kingdom-citizens' substance contrasts with — the substance of the Father-as-the-treasure (Mishlei (Proverbs) 30:8-9, Yirmeyahu (Jeremiah) 9:23-24).

quote: And now let us do what we purposed: For we have gathered silver, And many are the husbandmen in our houses.
live_here: Woe to you, ye rich, for ye have trusted in your riches, And from your riches shall ye depart, Because ye have not remembered the El Elyon (Most High) in the days of your riches.
live_proposed: And now let us do what we purposed: For we have gathered silver, And many are the husbandmen in our houses.’ And our granaries are (brim) full as with water,
note: *And now let us do what we purposed: For we have gathered silver, And many are the husbandmen in our houses.* 1 Enoch 94:8 names the Enochic wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the rich-man's-internal-monologue — the *let us do what we purposed* substance that-presupposes the gathered-silver and the many-husbandmen as-the-foundation-for-doing-what-the-rich-man-has-purposed. The framework reads the verse against Matt 19:24's camel-through-the-eye-of-a-needle hyperbole — the impossibility-deliberately-stated. The Enochic-substance names the substance directly — the rich-man-presumes-on-his-resources to-do-what-he-has-purposed (the substance the King-will-name explicitly in the rich-fool parable at Luke 12:16-21's *I will pull down my barns, and build greater; and there will I bestow all my fruits and my goods*). The substance the rich-man-presumes-on is the substance-that-cannot-fit through-the-eye-of-the-needle. The wisdom-stream and the gospel cohere at the architecture — the substance-the-rich-man-presumes-on against-the-substance-the-Father-actually-provides.

quote: And now, know ye that ye are prepared for the day of destruction: Wherefore do not hope to live, ye sinners, but ye shall depart and die; For ye know no ransom; for ye are prepared for the day of the great judgement.
live_here: And now, know ye that ye are prepared for the day of destruction: wherefore do not hope to live, ye sinners, but ye shall depart and die; for ye know no ransom; for ye are prepared for the day of the great judgement, for the day of tribulation and great shame for your spirits.
live_proposed: And now, know ye that ye are prepared for the day of destruction: wherefore do not hope to live, ye sinners, but ye shall depart and die; for ye know no ransom; for ye are prepared for the day of the great judgement, for the day of tribulation and great shame for your spirits.
note: *And now, know ye that ye are prepared for the day of destruction: Wherefore do not hope to live, ye sinners, but ye shall depart and die; For ye know no ransom; for ye are prepared for the day of the great judgement.* 1 Enoch 98:10 names the Enochic wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the *ye know no ransom* substance — the substance the disciples' *who then can be saved?* at Matt 19:25 presupposes-the-failure-of. The framework reads the verse against the disciples' question. The Enochic-substance names the substance directly: the rich-sinner-substance-presumes-on-the-substance-of-riches-as-ransom; the substance is failed-substance — *ye know no ransom.* The disciples' question at v.25 — *who then can be saved?* — presupposes the inherited-substance that-had-associated-material-prosperity-with-the-Father's-blessing (Bereshit (Genesis) 13:2, 26:12, Devarim (Deuteronomy) 28's covenant-blessings); if-even-the-substance-the-Tanakh-treats-as-blessing is-an-obstacle, who-can-be-saved? The Enochic-substance had named the architecture-of-the-failure-of-the-rich-man's-ransom; the King's-substance at v.26 will-name the substance the Father makes-possible against-the-substance the natural-substance-finds-impossible.

quote: And (then) the children of the earth shall see the wise in security, And shall understand all the words of this book, And recognize that their riches shall not be able to save them In the overthrow of their unrighteousness.
live_here: And (then) the children of the earth shall see the wise in security, And shall understand all the words of this book, And recognize that their riches shall not be able to save them In the overthrow of their sins.
live_proposed: And (then) the children of the earth shall see the wise in security, And shall understand all the words of this book, And recognize that their riches shall not be able to save them In the overthrow of their sins.
note: *And (then) the children of the earth shall see the wise in security, And shall understand all the words of this book, And recognize that their riches shall not be able to save them In the overthrow of their unrighteousness.* 1 Enoch 100:6 names THE direct Enochic wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the *riches shall not be able to save them* substance — the substance the King names at Matt 19:26's *with men this is impossible; but with Elohim (God) all things are possible.* The framework reads the verse against the King's-statement. The Enochic-substance names the architecture directly: the rich-substance cannot-save; the natural-substance cannot-accomplish the kingdom-entry-substance. The King's-substance at v.26 lands the substance the Father makes-possible — the new-heart-substance of Yechezk'el (Ezekiel) 36:26-27's *a new heart also will I give you... I will put my spirit within you, and cause you to walk in my statutes.* The Father's-substance is the substance that-softens-the-heart-the-possessions-hold and-enables-the-substance the natural-substance-cannot-walk. The framework rules out the universalist-reading the substance does NOT support — the substance is NOT that all-rich-men-will-be-saved regardless-of-disposition; the substance is that the Father's-substance is-able-to-soften the substance the natural-substance-finds-impossible per Ezekiel 36:26-27 + Yirmeyahu (Jeremiah) 31:33's heart-Torah architecture. Grace is the door-home, the means-of-return-to-the-Father's-Way, NOT the cancellation-of-the-substance-the-Father-commands per the *Grace, the Way, the New Heart, and the Mercy of Depart* section of framework-deep.md.

quote: And it shall come to pass in those days that the elect and holy children of the earth will behold the secrets of the heaven, and the kingdom of the Elect One shall be revealed to them, and they shall rejoice and be glad.

The framework reads the verse against Matt 26:64's *coming in the clouds of heaven* — the Daniel 7:13-14 substance the King quotes walks the substantial-everlasting-dominion-substance (*and there was given him dominion, and glory, and a kingdom, that all people, nations, and languages, should serve him: his dominion is an everlasting dominion, which shall not pass away*); 1 Enoch 62 names the operative-substance the wisdom-stream walks-the-substance-for. The two-substances walk-substantively-at-the-substantial-same-substance the King-of-Yashar'el (Israel) walks-out-substantively at-the-Sanhedrin-trial-substance.

quote: And all the kings and the mighty and the exalted and those who rule the earth shall fall down on their faces before him and worship and set their hope upon that Son of Adam, and shall petition him and supplicate for mercy at his hands.

note: *And all the kings and the mighty and the exalted and those who rule the earth shall fall down on their faces before him and worship and set their hope upon that Son of Adam, and shall petition him and supplicate for mercy at his hands.* 1 Enoch 63:3 names the wisdom-stream's articulation of the kings-and-the-mighty-falling-down-before-the-Son-of-Adam-on-the-day-of-judgement substance. The framework reads the verse against Matt 26:64-66's Sanhedrin-condemnation — the corrupt-Sanhedrin-aristocracy condemning-the-King at-the-historical-pivot will-themselves-fall-down-before-the-same-Son-of-Adam-they-condemned at the eschatological-day-of-vindication. The substantial-1-Enoch-63 substance walks-substantively the substantial-direct-articulation of the substantial-Tanakh-substance the prophet-Yeshayahu (Isaiah) walked at Isaiah 45:23 (*unto me every knee shall bow, every tongue shall swear*) and the apostle-Sha'ul (Paul) walks at Philippians 2:10-11 (*at the name of Yahusha (Jesus) every knee should bow* + *every tongue should confess that Yahusha (Jesus) HaMashiach (Christ) is Lord*). The substantial-substance walks the substantial-direct-rule-out of any-Universalist-collapse — the falling-down-on-their-faces of 1 Enoch 63:3 + Isaiah 45:23 + Philippians 2:10-11 is the substantial-acknowledgement-of-the-Son-of-Adam-as-Lord, NOT-substantially-the-categorical-substance-of-the-substantial-universal-saved-substance the modern-Christian-and-Hebrew-Roots-Universalism walks (the acknowledgement-of-Lordship-substance does-not-walk-into-categorical-universal-salvation; the post-acknowledgement-substance walks-substantively-into-the-substantial-day-of-the-vindication-of-the-righteous-and-the-judgement-of-the-wicked-substance per 1 Enoch 63:4-6, 9 + Daniel 7:9-12).

quote: In those days shall the kings and the mighty and the exalted and those who possess the earth Be summoned, And they shall be made to stand before the Elect One on that day of judgement.
live_here: In those days shall the mighty and the kings who possess the earth implore (Him) to grant them a little respite from His angels of punishment to whom they were delivered, that they might fall down and worship before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, and confess their sins before Him.
live_proposed: And Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits seated him on the throne of His glory, And the spirit of righteousness was poured out upon him, And the word of his mouth slays all the sinners, And all the unrighteous are destroyed from before his face.
note: *In those days shall the kings and the mighty and the exalted and those who possess the earth Be summoned, And they shall be made to stand before the Elect One on that day of judgement.* 1 Enoch 63:1 names THE direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the kings-and-the-mighty-and-the-exalted-summoned-before-the-Elect-One architecture. The framework reads the verse against Matt 27:1's *when the morning was come, all the chief priests and elders of the people took counsel against Yahusha (Jesus) to put him to death* — the morning-council the substantial-Sanhedrin-leadership walks-out at the historical-pivot is the architectural-inverse of the day-of-vindication-summons the wisdom-stream had named. The kings-and-the-mighty-and-the-exalted-of-the-historical-pivot (the corrupted-Sanhedrin-leadership + the Roman-prefect Pontius-Pilate + Hordos (Herod)-Antipas) take-counsel-against-the-Anointed at the substance per Tehillim (Psalm) 2:2 + Acts 4:25-28; the kings-and-the-mighty-and-the-exalted-of-the-day-of-vindication shall-be-summoned-before-the-Elect-One per the eschatological-reversal. The wisdom-stream had named the architecture; the cross walks-out the present-tense-suffering-substance that-precedes-the-vindication-substance.

quote: And He will summon all the host of the heavens, and all the holy ones above, And the host of Elohim (God), the Cherubim, Seraphim and Ophanim, And all the angels of power, and all the angels of principalities, And the Elect One, and the other powers on the earth, and over the water, On that day.
live_here: And there shall stand up in that day all the kings and the mighty, And the exalted and those who hold the earth, And they shall see and recognize How he sits on the throne of his glory, And righteousness is judged before him, And no lying word is spoken before him.
live_proposed: And He will summon all the host of the heavens, and all the holy ones above, and the host of Elohim (God), the Cherubin, Seraphin and Ophannin, and all the angels of power, and all the angels of principalities, and the Elect One, and the other powers on the earth (and) over the water.
note: *And He will summon all the host of the heavens, and all the holy ones above, And the host of Elohim (God), the Cherubim, Seraphim and Ophanim, And all the angels of power, and all the angels of principalities, And the Elect One, and the other powers on the earth, and over the water, On that day.* 1 Enoch 62:3 names the wisdom-stream's articulation of the Elect-One-summoned-with-the-host-of-the-heavens substance. The framework reads the verse against Matt 27:42's mockers' *if he be the King of Yashar'el (Israel), let him now come down from the cross, and we will believe him* — the mockers cannot-see the architecture the wisdom-stream named: the Elect-One's-credential is NOT the come-down-from-the-cross substance the mockers demand; the Elect-One's-credential is the summoning-with-the-host-of-the-heavens at the day-of-vindication. The King COULD-have-summoned-twelve-legions-of-angels per Matt 26:53; he walks-the-cross-substantively per the Father's-purpose-substance. The wisdom-stream had named the architecture-of-the-Elect-One-summoning-the-heavenly-host; the cross is the present-tense-suspension-of-the-architecture for the substance of the Father's-purpose-walking-out-the-Pesach-lamb-substance.

quote: And Yahuah (God) of Spirits said: ‘This is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness, And righteousness abides over him, And the righteousness of the Head of Days forsakes him not.’
live_here: For from the beginning the Son of Adam was hidden, And the El Elyon (Most High) preserved him in the presence of His might, And revealed him to the elect.
live_proposed: And he (i.e. the angel) came to me and greeted me with His voice, and said unto me: ‘This is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness, And righteousness abides over him, And the righteousness of the Head of Days forsakes him not.’
note: *And Yahuah (God) of Spirits said: ‘This is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness, And righteousness abides over him, And the righteousness of the Head of Days forsakes him not.’* 1 Enoch 62:7 names THE direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the *righteousness of the Head of Days forsakes him not* substance — the wisdom-stream had named the architecture of the Son-of-Adam's-being-not-forsaken centuries before the cross. The framework reads the verse against Matt 27:43's mockers' *he trusted in Elohim (God); let him deliver him now, if he will have him: for he said, I am the Son of Elohim (God)* AND against Matt 27:46's *Eli, Eli, lama sabachthani — my Elohim (God), my Elohim (God), why hast thou forsaken me?* The mockers' framing reads-the-cross as the apparent-forsakenness; the wisdom-stream had named the operative-truth: the righteousness-of-the-Head-of-Days forsakes-him-not. The King's-prayer at v.46 is the Suffering-Servant-praying-Tehillim (Psalm) 22 — the Psalm that begins in apparent-forsakenness (Tehillim 22:1) but ends in vindication (Tehillim 22:22-31's *I will declare thy name unto my brethren* + *all the ends of the world shall remember and turn unto Yahuah (the LORD)*). Per Red Line #10's nature-of-God reading: this is NOT the Trinity-co-equal-person-being-forsaken-by-the-Father reading; the framework reads the Formed-Son in the submission-to-the-Formless-Father praying the Psalm-of-vindication-through-suffering. The wisdom-stream and the gospel cohere at the *righteousness-of-the-Head-of-Days-forsakes-him-not* architecture.

quote: And all the kings and the mighty and the exalted and those who rule the earth Shall fall down on their faces before him and worship and set their hope upon that Son of Adam, And shall petition him and supplicate for mercy at his hands.
live_here: And splendid in every secret thing is Thy power from generation to generation, And Thy glory for ever and ever: Deep are all Thy secrets and innumerable, And Thy righteousness is beyond reckoning.
live_proposed: And all the kings and the mighty and the exalted and those who rule the earth Shall fall down before him on their faces, And worship and set their hope upon that Son of Adam, And petition him and supplicate for mercy at his hands.
note: *And all the kings and the mighty and the exalted and those who rule the earth Shall fall down on their faces before him and worship and set their hope upon that Son of Adam, And shall petition him and supplicate for mercy at his hands.* 1 Enoch 63:3 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the eschatological-reversal — the kings-and-the-mighty who-presently-mock at the cross shall-eventually fall-down-on-their-faces and worship the Son-of-Adam. The framework reads the verse against Matt 27:42's mockers' *let him now come down from the cross, and we will believe him* AND against Philippians 2:10-11's *that at the name of Yahusha (Jesus) every knee should bow, of things in heaven, and things in earth, and things under the earth; and that every tongue should confess that Yahusha (Jesus) HaMashiach (Christ) is Lord, to the glory of Elohim (God) the Father.* The wisdom-stream had named the reversal-architecture: the present-tense-mocking-at-the-cross is the architectural-inverse of the eschatological-confession-and-worship; the same-figures who-presently-mock will eventually-bow. The framework reads this carefully against Red Line #11's post-harvest-sifting architecture — the eschatological-bowing is the universal-acknowledgment, not the universal-salvation; the kings-and-the-mighty who-do-not-extol-Yahuah's-name-substantively face-the-shame-and-darkness per 1 Enoch 62:11-12 + 63:11. The wisdom-stream had named the reversal; the cross walks-out the present-tense-suffering-substance that precedes-the-vindication-substance.

quote: And in those days shall the earth also give back that which has been entrusted to it, and Sheol also shall give back that which it has received, and hell shall give back that which it owes ... For in those days the Elect One shall arise.
live_here: And in those days shall the earth also give back that which has been entrusted to it, And Sheol also shall give back that which it has received, And hell shall give back that which it owes.
live_proposed: And in those days shall the earth also give back that which has been entrusted to it, And Sheol also shall give back that which it has received, And hell shall give back that which it owes.
note: *And in those days shall the earth also give back that which has been entrusted to it, and Sheol also shall give back that which it has received, and hell shall give back that which it owes ... For in those days the Elect One shall arise.* 1 Enoch 51:1 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the Elect-One-shall-arise + earth-shall-give-back-the-dead substance — the Resurrection-architecture the King-of-Yashar'el (Israel) walks as the firstfruits at-Matt 28:6 and the citizens-of-the-kingdom will walk at the first-resurrection per Revelation 20:4-6. The framework reads the verse against Matt 28:18's *All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth.* The Elect-One-arising-substance the wisdom-stream names IS the King-of-Yashar'el (Israel) walking-out the substantial-Resurrection-substance at-Matt 28:1-10 + the substantial-dominion-substance at-Matt 28:18 — the firstfruits-arising and the dominion-given-substance walk-in-the-same-architecture the wisdom-stream had named the Elect-One-substance for. The framework reads this in continuity with the S146 Matt 16 thread `the-gates-of-sheol-and-the-resurrection-substance-in-wisdom-of-solomon-and-1-enoch` (anchored at the Resurrection-credential of-the-sign-of-Yonah pre-announced at Matt 16:4) — Matt 28 is the operative-event the wisdom-stream-architecture had named. FRAMEWORK-MAJOR.

quote: And he shall choose the righteous and holy from among them: For the day has drawn nigh that they should be saved.
live_here: And he shall choose the righteous and holy from among them: For the day has drawn nigh that they should be saved.
live_proposed: And he shall choose the righteous and holy from among them: For the day has drawn nigh that they should be saved.
note: *And he shall choose the righteous and holy from among them: For the day has drawn nigh that they should be saved.* 1 Enoch 51:2 names the wisdom-stream's articulation of the Elect-One-shall-choose-the-righteous-and-holy substance — the post-harvest-sifting of the wheat from the wheat-mixed-with-chaff substance per Red Line #11 + Matt 13:30 (*let both grow together until the harvest*) + Matt 25:31-46 (the sheep-and-goats). The framework reads the verse against Matt 28:18's *All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth.* The substantial-all-power-substance the King receives at v.18 is the operative-substance for the day-has-drawn-nigh-that-they-should-be-saved substance the wisdom-stream had named — the Elect-One walks-the-substantial-choosing-of-the-righteous-and-holy because the substantial-all-power-substance is-substantively-given. The framework reads this in continuity with the post-harvest-sifting per Red Line #11 — the wheat is gathered out of all nations (Ezekiel 37:21) into the wilderness (Ezekiel 20:35), purges-out-the-rebels (Ezekiel 20:38), brought-into-the-bond-of-the-new-covenant (Jeremiah 31:31), and then grafted-into-the-natural-root-of-the-fathers (Romans 11:24). The Elect-One-choosing-the-righteous-and-holy is the substance the wisdom-stream had named at the architecture-level; the substantial-all-power-given-substance is the operative-substance for the choosing to walk.

quote: And Yahuah (God) of Spirits seated the Elect One on the throne of His glory, And he shall judge all the secret things, And no one shall be able to utter a lying word in his presence.
live_here: And the kings and the mighty and all who possess the earth shall bless and glorify and extol him who rules over all, who was hidden.
live_proposed: And Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits placed the Elect One on the throne of glory. And he shall judge all the works of the holy above in the heaven, And in the balance shall their deeds be weighed.
note: *And Yahuah (God) of Spirits seated the Elect One on the throne of His glory, And he shall judge all the secret things, And no one shall be able to utter a lying word in his presence.* 1 Enoch 62:6 names THE direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the Father-seated-the-Elect-One-on-the-throne-of-His-glory substance — the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the substantial Daniel 7:13-14 dominion-and-glory-and-a-kingdom substance the King walks-out at-Matt 28:18 + the substantial Psalm 110:1 right-hand-of-the-Father-substance the prophet-David walked. The framework reads the verse against Matt 28:18's *All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth.* The Father-of-Spirits seated-the-Elect-One-on-the-throne-of-His-glory substance the wisdom-stream names at 1 Enoch 62:6 is the substantial-substance the King walks-into at the substantial-Resurrection-and-Ascension substance Matt 28:18 names + Ephesians 1:20-22 + Hebrews 1:3 articulate at the apostolic-register. Per Red Line #12, the Son-of-Adam-architecture the framework reads runs through 1 Enoch 46-71's named-figure-of-the-Son-of-Adam-Elect-One (the named-Standard, NOT the kaph-comparative case of Daniel 7:13 / Revelation 1:13 / Revelation 14:14 the Red Line carves-out). The substantial-substance: the Son-of-Adam-given-all-dominion at-Matt 28:18 is the substantial-substance the wisdom-stream had named the throne-of-glory-substance for centuries before. FRAMEWORK-MAJOR.

quote: And this Son of Adam whom thou hast seen Shall raise up the kings and the mighty from their seats, And the strong from their thrones, And shall loosen the reins of the strong, And break the teeth of the sinners.
live_here: And all the kings and the mighty and the exalted and those who rule the earth Shall fall down before him on their faces, And worship and set their hope upon that Son of Adam, And petition him and supplicate for mercy at his hands.
live_proposed: And this Son of Adam whom thou hast seen Shall raise up the kings and the mighty from their seats, [And the strong from their thrones] And shall loosen the reins of the strong, And break the teeth of the sinners.
note: *And this Son of Adam whom thou hast seen Shall raise up the kings and the mighty from their seats, And the strong from their thrones, And shall loosen the reins of the strong, And break the teeth of the sinners.* 1 Enoch 62:9 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the Son-of-Adam-raising-up-and-putting-down-the-kings-and-the-mighty substance — the substantial-categorical-dominion-substance the substantial-King walks-out at the substantial-day-of-vindication. The framework reads the verse against Matt 28:18's *All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth.* The substantial-all-power-substance the King receives at v.18 is the operative-substance for the substance the wisdom-stream had named the architecture for — the Son-of-Adam-raising-up-and-putting-down-the-kings the apostle Yochanan (John) names at Revelation 6:15-17 + 19:11-21 + the substance Daniel 2:44 named the everlasting-kingdom-that-breaks-in-pieces-and-consumes-all-the-kingdoms-substance for. The substantial-categorical-dominion-substance is heaven-and-earth-substantially-comprehensively — NOT the inherited-Christian-spiritualized-kingdom-only-in-heaven substance; the substantial-substance is the operative-millennial-reign-on-the-earth + the everlasting-reign in-the-new-heavens-and-the-new-earth per Revelation 21-22.

quote: And the Head of Days placed the Elect One on the throne of His glory; And he shall judge all the works of the holy in heaven above, And weigh their deeds in the balance.
live_here: And Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits placed the Elect One on the throne of glory. And he shall judge all the works of the holy above in the heaven, And in the balance shall their deeds be weighed.
live_proposed: And Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits placed the Elect One on the throne of glory. And he shall judge all the works of the holy above in the heaven, And in the balance shall their deeds be weighed.
note: *And the Head of Days placed the Elect One on the throne of His glory; And he shall judge all the works of the holy in heaven above, And weigh their deeds in the balance.* 1 Enoch 61:8 names the wisdom-stream's articulation of the Head-of-Days-placed-the-Elect-One-on-the-throne-of-His-glory substance — paired with the substantial-judging-and-weighing-of-the-deeds substance at the post-harvest-sifting-day-of-judgment. The framework reads the verse against Matt 28:18's *All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth.* The Head-of-Days at 1 Enoch 61:8 is the Father — the Formless-Source per the framework's nature-of-God reading + the same Head-of-Days the prophet-Daniel walked at Daniel 7:9-14; the Elect-One is the Son — the Formed-Expression. The placing-on-the-throne-of-His-glory substance the wisdom-stream names is operative at Matt 28:18 — the King-of-Yashar'el (Israel) at the substantial-Resurrection-and-Ascension receives the substantial-all-power-substance the Father gives. The judging-and-weighing-of-deeds substance is the post-harvest-sifting per Red Line #11 — the substance Matt 7:21-23 (*Lord, Lord ... I never knew you*) + Matt 25:31-46 (the sheep-and-goats) articulate at the gospel-substance the wisdom-stream had named.

quote: And Yahuah (God) said unto Michael: "Go, bind Semjâzâ and his associates who have united themselves with women... bind them fast for seventy generations in the valleys of the earth, till the day of their judgement and of their consummation."
live_here: And Yahuah (Lord) said unto Michael: ‘Go, bind Semjâzâ and his associates who have united themselves with women so as to have defiled themselves with them in all their uncleanness.
live_proposed: And Yahuah (Lord) said unto Michael: ‘Go, bind Semjâzâ and his associates who have united themselves with women so as to have defiled themselves with them in all their uncleanness.
note: *And Yahuah (God) said unto Michael: "Go, bind Semjâzâ and his associates who have united themselves with women... bind them fast for seventy generations in the valleys of the earth, till the day of their judgement and of their consummation."* (1 Enoch 10:11-12.) The binding of Semjaza and the watchers in the valleys of the earth until the day of judgement is the same strong-man-bound architecture Mark 3:27 names. The spoiling of the strong-man's house — the casting-out of devils the chapter is contesting — presupposes the binding the Enochic library already recorded.

quote: And again Yahuah (God) said to Raphael: "Bind Azâzêl hand and foot, and cast him into the darkness: and make an opening in the desert, which is in Dûdâêl, and cast him therein."
live_here: And again Yahuah (Lord) said to Raphael: ‘Bind Azâzêl hand and foot, and cast him into the darkness: and make an opening in the desert, which is in Dûdâêl, and cast him therein.
live_proposed: And again Yahuah (Lord) said to Raphael: ‘Bind Azâzêl hand and foot, and cast him into the darkness: and make an opening in the desert, which is in Dûdâêl, and cast him therein.
note: *And again Yahuah (God) said to Raphael: "Bind Azâzêl hand and foot, and cast him into the darkness: and make an opening in the desert, which is in Dûdâêl, and cast him therein."* 1 Enoch 10:4-6 names the binding of Azazel hand-and-foot, cast into the desert-darkness, reserved *on the day of the great judgement* to be cast into the fire. Mark 3:27's *no man can enter into a strong man's house, and spoil his goods, except he will first bind the strong man; and then he will spoil his house* walks the same binding-architecture: the King's ministry is the incursion that binds the strong-man so the captives can be released. The Enochic library supplies the typological anchor the gospel walks.

quote: Here shall stand the angels who have connected themselves with women, and their spirits assuming many different forms are defiling mankind and shall lead them astray into sacrificing to demons as gods, here shall they stand, till the day of the great judgement in which they shall be judged till they are made an end of.
live_here: And Uriel said to me: ‘Here shall stand the angels who have connected themselves with women, and their spirits assuming many different forms are defiling mankind and shall lead them astray into sacrificing to demons as gods, (here shall they stand,) till the day of the great judgement in which they shall be judged till they are made an end of.
live_proposed: And Uriel said to me: ‘Here shall stand the angels who have connected themselves with women, and their spirits assuming many different forms are defiling mankind and shall lead them astray into sacrificing to demons as gods, (here shall they stand,) till the day of the great judgement in which they shall be judged till they are made an end of.
note: *Here shall stand the angels who have connected themselves with women, and their spirits assuming many different forms are defiling mankind and shall lead them astray into sacrificing to demons as gods, here shall they stand, till the day of the great judgement in which they shall be judged till they are made an end of.* 1 Enoch 19:1 names the watcher-spirits and their appointed standing-place of judgement. At Mark 3:11 the unclean spirits *fell down before him, and cried, saying, Thou art the Son of Elohim (God)* — the watcher-administration recognizing the Judge before whom it must one day stand, falling down before the Formed one whose great-judgement-day is named in the Enochic library.

quote: And from the beginning thus have I been shown concerning you, and written concerning you... Say to them therefore: "You have no peace."
live_here: From the days of the slaughter and destruction and death of the giants, from the souls of whose flesh the spirits, having gone forth, shall destroy without incurring judgement—thus shall they destroy until the day of the consummation, the great judgement in which the age shall be consummated, over the Watchers and the godless, yea, shall be wholly consummated."
live_proposed: “You have been in heaven, but all the mysteries had not yet been revealed to you, and you knew worthless ones, and these in the hardness of your hearts you have made known to the women, and through these mysteries women and men work much evil on earth."
note: *And from the beginning thus have I been shown concerning you, and written concerning you... Say to them therefore: "You have no peace."* (1 Enoch 16:1, 16:4.) The watchers and the evil spirits gone forth from their giant-offspring *have no peace* — the sentence is written from the beginning. The unclean spirit's cry *Let us alone; what have we to do with thee?* (Mark 1:24) is the no-peace condition speaking: it knows the Holy One's coming is the disturbance of a peace it was never granted.

quote: From the days of the slaughter and destruction and death of the giants, from the souls of whose flesh the spirits, having gone forth, shall destroy without incurring judgement—thus shall they destroy until the day of the consummation, the great judgement.
live_here: And the spirits of the giants afflict, oppress, destroy, attack, do battle, and work destruction on the earth, and cause trouble: they take no food, but nevertheless hunger and thirst, and cause offences.
live_proposed: From the days of the slaughter and destruction and death of the giants, from the souls of whose flesh the spirits, having gone forth, shall destroy without incurring judgement—thus shall they destroy until the day of the consummation, the great judgement in which the age shall be consummated, over the Watchers and the godless, yea, shall be wholly consummated."
note: *From the days of the slaughter and destruction and death of the giants, from the souls of whose flesh the spirits, having gone forth, shall destroy without incurring judgement—thus shall they destroy until the day of the consummation, the great judgement.* 1 Enoch 15:11 names the unclean spirit's origin and its appointed end: the spirits gone forth from the giants destroy until the day of the great judgement. The demon's own question at Mark 1:24 — *art thou come to destroy us?* — names that it knows its judgement-day is fixed; the watchers' offspring recognize that the Holy One of Elohim is the one who holds the day of their consummation.

quote: And now, the giants, who are produced from the spirits and flesh, shall be called evil spirits upon the earth, and on the earth shall be their dwelling.
live_here: But you were formerly spiritual, living the eternal life, and immortal for all generations of the world.
live_proposed: And now, the giants, who are produced from the spirits and flesh, shall be called evil spirits upon the earth, and on the earth shall be their dwelling.
note: *And now, the giants, who are produced from the spirits and flesh, shall be called evil spirits upon the earth, and on the earth shall be their dwelling.* (1 Enoch 15:6-7 reads: *Evil spirits have proceeded from their bodies; because they are born from men and from the holy Watchers is their beginning and primal origin... And the spirits of the giants afflict, oppress, destroy, attack, do battle, and work destruction on the earth.*) The unclean spirit that cries in the synagogue — *I know thee who thou art, the Holy One of Elohim (God)* — is one of these: an evil spirit gone forth from the slain giants' flesh, the watchers' offspring under restraint. It recognizes the Formed one before the watching crowd can name him because it was there at the rebellion. The recognition is not the sheep's hearing; the demons know and tremble, and the King silences them.

quote: their spirits assuming many different forms are defiling mankind and shall lead them astray into sacrificing to demons as gods, here shall they stand, till the day of the great judgement.
live_here: And Uriel said to me: ‘Here shall stand the angels who have connected themselves with women, and their spirits assuming many different forms are defiling mankind and shall lead them astray into sacrificing to demons as gods, (here shall they stand,) till the day of the great judgement in which they shall be judged till they are made an end of.
live_proposed: And Uriel said to me: ‘Here shall stand the angels who have connected themselves with women, and their spirits assuming many different forms are defiling mankind and shall lead them astray into sacrificing to demons as gods, (here shall they stand,) till the day of the great judgement in which they shall be judged till they are made an end of.
note: *And see him that was possessed with the devil, and had the legion, sitting, and clothed, and in his right mind: and they were afraid.* The man restored to his right mind is the reversal of what the Hebrew library says these spirits do: *their spirits assuming many different forms are defiling mankind and shall lead them astray into sacrificing to demons as gods, here shall they stand, till the day of the great judgement.* (1 Enoch 19:1) The leading-astray-into-demon-worship is undone in the one man, a sign-in-miniature of the judgement reserved for the spirits themselves.

quote: And from the beginning thus have I been shown concerning you, and written concerning you.
live_here: From the days of the slaughter and destruction and death of the giants, from the souls of whose flesh the spirits, having gone forth, shall destroy without incurring judgement—thus shall they destroy until the day of the consummation, the great judgement in which the age shall be consummated, over the Watchers and the godless, yea, shall be wholly consummated."
live_proposed: And after that Enoch both gave and began to recount from the books.
note: *For he said unto him, Come out of the man, thou unclean spirit.* 1 Enoch 16:1 names the spirits the command addresses by their origin in the slain giants: *And from the beginning thus have I been shown concerning you, and written concerning you.* The unclean spirit is not a faceless force; the Hebrew library had recorded its lineage and its sentence — *Say to them therefore: "You have no peace."* (1 Enoch 16:4) — long before the King commanded it out of the man.

quote: destroy without incurring judgement... until the day of the consummation, the great judgement
live_here: And the spirits of the giants afflict, oppress, destroy, attack, do battle, and work destruction on the earth, and cause trouble: they take no food, but nevertheless hunger and thirst, and cause offences.
live_proposed: From the days of the slaughter and destruction and death of the giants, from the souls of whose flesh the spirits, having gone forth, shall destroy without incurring judgement—thus shall they destroy until the day of the consummation, the great judgement in which the age shall be consummated, over the Watchers and the godless, yea, shall be wholly consummated."
note: *And the unclean spirits went out, and entered into the swine: and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the sea... and were choked in the sea.* The spirits the King casts out are the spirits the Hebrew library says *destroy without incurring judgement... until the day of the consummation, the great judgement* (1 Enoch 15:11). The drowning in the sea is not their final judgement — that waits for the day of the great judgement over the Watchers and the godless; it is the King displacing their administration of the eastern territory in one motion before the day appointed for their end.

quote: And the spirits of the giants afflict, oppress, destroy, attack, do battle, and work destruction on the earth, and cause trouble: they take no food, but nevertheless hunger and thirst, and cause offences.
live_here: Evil spirits have proceeded from their bodies; because they are born from men and from the holy Watchers is their beginning and primal origin; they shall be evil spirits on earth, and evil spirits shall they be called.
live_proposed: And the spirits of the giants afflict, oppress, destroy, attack, do battle, and work destruction on the earth, and cause trouble: they take no food, but nevertheless hunger and thirst, and cause offences.
note: *My name is Legion: for we are many.* 1 Enoch 15:9 names what the legion of unclean spirits does to the man among the tombs: *And the spirits of the giants afflict, oppress, destroy, attack, do battle, and work destruction on the earth, and cause trouble: they take no food, but nevertheless hunger and thirst, and cause offences.* The afflicting, oppressing, self-destroying torment of the Gadarene man — crying and cutting himself with stones, night and day — is the work the Hebrew library attributes to the spirits of the giants.

quote: As for the spirits of heaven, in heaven shall be their dwelling, but as for the spirits of the earth which were born upon the earth, on the earth shall be their dwelling.
live_here: And now, the giants, who are produced from the spirits and flesh, shall be called evil spirits upon the earth, and on the earth shall be their dwelling.
live_proposed: [As for the spirits of heaven, in heaven shall be their dwelling, but as for the spirits of the earth which were born upon the earth, on the earth shall be their dwelling.]
note: *And he asked him, What is thy name? And he answered, saying, My name is Legion: for we are many.* The unclean spirits that are *many* in one man are the evil spirits the Hebrew library names by origin: *As for the spirits of heaven, in heaven shall be their dwelling, but as for the spirits of the earth which were born upon the earth, on the earth shall be their dwelling.* (1 Enoch 15:8) The earth-bound spirits are a multitude precisely because they proceeded from the slain giants; *Legion* is the gospel's word for the same class 1 Enoch had already located on the earth.

quote: And there was a holy mountain, and under the mountain to the east there was a stream flowing, and to the south another stream.
live_here: Then Uriel, one of the holy angels who was with me, answered and said: ‘This accursed valley is for those who are accursed for ever: Here shall all the accursed be gathered together who utter with their lips against Yahuah (Lord) unseemly words and of His glory speak hard things. Here shall they be gathered together, and here shall be their place of judgement.
live_proposed: And I went from thence to the middle of the earth, and I saw a blessed place in which there were trees with branches abiding and blooming [of a dismembered tree].
note: *And there was a holy mountain, and under the mountain to the east there was a stream flowing, and to the south another stream.* 1 Enoch 27:1-3 places the accursed valley — the Hinnom-shaped place of punishment for the godless — beside the holy mountain, the very Ge-Hinnom topography the gospel's *hell* (Gehenna) draws its name from. The King's *cut it off ... than having two hands to go into hell* (Mark 9:43) walks the same place-of-judgment architecture 1 Enoch maps at the middle of the earth: the accursed valley appointed for the day of judgment.

quote: And these places have been made for them until the day of their judgement and until their appointed period, till the great judgement comes upon them.
live_here: Here their spirits shall be set apart in this great pain till the great day of judgement and punishment and torment of those who curse for ever and retribution for their spirits. There He shall bind them for ever.
live_proposed: And these places have been made to receive them till the day of their judgement and till their appointed period [till the period appointed], till the great judgement (comes) upon them.’
note: *And these places have been made for them until the day of their judgement and until their appointed period, till the great judgement comes upon them.* 1 Enoch 22:11 names the place where the spirits of the dead are set apart against the great judgement — the framework-honest holding of the dead until the day, the architecture behind Mark 9:43-48's *hell* (Gehenna). 1 Enoch 22 carries the same two-compartment structure the King names elsewhere; the place of punishment Mark warns against is the place 1 Enoch had already mapped, not the inherited eternal-torment caricature.

quote: And this Son of Adam whom thou hast seen shall raise up the kings and the mighty from their seats, and the strong from their thrones, and shall loosen the reins of the strong, and break the teeth of the sinners.
live_here: And all the kings and the mighty and the exalted and those who rule the earth Shall fall down before him on their faces, And worship and set their hope upon that Son of Adam, And petition him and supplicate for mercy at his hands.
live_proposed: And this Son of Adam whom thou hast seen Shall raise up the kings and the mighty from their seats, [And the strong from their thrones] And shall loosen the reins of the strong, And break the teeth of the sinners.
note: *And this Son of Adam whom thou hast seen shall raise up the kings and the mighty from their seats, and the strong from their thrones, and shall loosen the reins of the strong, and break the teeth of the sinners.* 1 Enoch 62:9 names again the judging-reversal of the enthroned Son of Adam — the kings and the mighty raised from their thrones before him. Mark 14:62's *coming in the clouds of heaven* binds the enthronement to the return: the same Son of Adam seated at the right hand of power comes to judge those who condemned him. The wisdom-stream named the kings-and-mighty-cast-down architecture the King invokes at the trial.

quote: And Yahuah (God) of Spirits said: This is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness, and righteousness abides over him, and the righteousness of the Head of Days forsakes him not.
live_here: For from the beginning the Son of Adam was hidden, And the El Elyon (Most High) preserved him in the presence of His might, And revealed him to the elect.
live_proposed: And he (i.e. the angel) came to me and greeted me with His voice, and said unto me: ‘This is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness, And righteousness abides over him, And the righteousness of the Head of Days forsakes him not.’
